biography:
Technology sales leader with 20+ years' sales and sales management experience, building and developing high-performing global sales teams with a track record of success, working with some of the most demanding blue chip global organisations across cloud, financial services and network services verticals in multiple countries. For the past 10 years focusing on supporting the growth ambitions of Hyperscalers and Cloud Service Providers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. 

Strong understanding of the technology landscape having worked with numerous service providers, resellers, manufacturers and partners, and having experience of leading global sales teams, working across time zones and technology disciplines, to create business value for clients. 

Passionate about setting and achieving ambitious goals, at work and outside work. I have organised and completed various charity challenges including rowing across the English Channel, rowing across Scotland and cycling to Paris in 24 hours, raising over £17k for Marie Curie Cancer Care.
